handback.title: Release v0.1.7 with the test baseline and key fixes
handback.summary: Cut release v0.1.7 naming both fixes merged since v0.1.6, so adopters can pin them.
handback.user_story: Adopters pin v0.1.7 and get the test baseline fix and the rejected model key fix.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the changelog is read, its newest section is v0.1.7, right above v0.1.6.
acceptance_criteria.words: a `## v0.1.7` heading at the top of CHANGELOG.md, newest above v0.1.6
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: The v0.1.7 section has one line for the test baseline fix, naming its pull request and issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: #929 (#928): the test baseline passes, with a notice, on a repo that has no tests folder yet, and runs scoped to the settings' folder and file pattern.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed file in the repo; the one test also checks the line names no other fix.

acceptance_criteria.text: The v0.1.7 section has one line for the rejected model key fix, naming its pull request and issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: #931 (#907): a model key the provider refuses ends the run as "Model key rejected", naming the secret to replace, instead of a missing plan; the setup audit tries each set agent key once.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It merged to main before this plan, so the owner's fallback of leaving it out no longer applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: The install file calls the entry workflow at v0.1.7.
acceptance_criteria.words: the install file `dokima/install/dokima.yml`, README and docs/wiki/Installing.md point at `entry.yml@v0.1.7`
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed line; older tests already guard the agent keys it hands over.

acceptance_criteria.text: The readme's install steps name v0.1.7 as the release, and no other version.
acceptance_criteria.words: the install file `dokima/install/dokima.yml`, README and docs/wiki/Installing.md point at `entry.yml@v0.1.7`
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed file in the repo; no input varies.

acceptance_criteria.words: the install file `dokima/install/dokima.yml`, README and docs/wiki/Installing.md point at `entry.yml@v0.1.7`
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed file in the repo; no input varies.
